Title: User Registration Login and Cart Creation
Preconditions:
1. API base URL https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com is accessible
2. API client or tool is available to send HTTP requests (e.g. Postman curl or Playwright API context)
3. A unique email address and a valid password meeting API complexity rules are prepared
Request / Test Steps:
1. Send POST https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com/users/register with JSON body containing first_name last_name unique email and valid password
2. Verify the registration response
3. Send POST https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com/users/login with JSON body containing the registered email and password
4. Extract the access_token from the login response
5. Send POST https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com/carts with header Authorization Bearer access_token and no request body unless required by documentation
6. Verify the cart creation response
Expected Result:
1. Registration returns a successful response and includes a user identifier
2. Login returns HTTP 200 with access_token token_type Bearer and expires_in in the response body
3. Cart creation returns a successful response with a cart id
4. Authenticated cart request is accepted only when a valid bearer token is supplied

Title: Complete API Checkout Lifecycle Products Cart and Invoice
Preconditions:
1. API base URL https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com is accessible
2. API client or tool is available to send HTTP requests
3. A unique email address and valid password are prepared for registration
API Endpoint(s):
POST /users/register
POST /users/login
POST /carts
GET /products
POST /carts/{cart_id}
GET /carts/{cart_id}
POST /invoices
Request / Test Steps:
1. Register a new user using POST /users/register with valid first_name last_name email and password
2. Log in using POST /users/login and obtain the access_token
3. Create a cart using POST /carts with Authorization Bearer access_token
4. Retrieve products using GET /products?in_stock=true
5. Select at least one in-stock product id from the response
6. Add the product to the cart using POST /carts/{cart_id} with JSON body containing product_id and quantity
7. Retrieve and verify the cart using GET /carts/{cart_id} with Authorization Bearer access_token
8. Generate an invoice using POST /invoices with Authorization Bearer access_token and JSON body containing billing_street billing_city billing_state billing_country billing_postal_code payment_method cash-on-delivery cart_id and payment_details object
9. Review the invoice response
Expected Result:
1. Registration and login succeed and a valid bearer token is returned
2. Cart is created and product is added successfully
3. GET /carts/{cart_id} returns cart_items matching the added product and quantity
4. POST /invoices returns a successful response with invoice details for the submitted cart
5. Invoice request using payment_method cash-on-delivery is accepted when valid billing fields and cart_id are supplied

Title: Login with Invalid Credentials
Preconditions:
1. API base URL https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com is accessible
2. API client or tool is available to send HTTP requests
Request / Test Steps:
1. Send POST https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com/users/login with JSON body containing an invalid email and/or invalid password
2. Review the HTTP status code and response body
3. Attempt to use any value returned in the response as a bearer token for POST /carts if a token is present
Expected Result:
1. API returns an authentication failure response such as HTTP 401 Unauthorized
2. Response does not provide a valid access_token for secured endpoints
3. Subsequent secured requests using invalid or missing credentials are rejected

Title: Guest User Can Create Cart Without Authentication
Preconditions:
1. API base URL https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com is accessible
2. API client or tool is available to send HTTP requests
Request / Test Steps:
1. Send POST https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com/carts without an Authorization header
2. Review the HTTP status code and response body
3. Optionally repeat the request with an empty or malformed Authorization header if supported by the test tool
Expected Result: Guest user is able to create a cart successfully. API returns HTTP 201 Created and a valid cart ID.

Title: Invoice Generation with Invalid or Incomplete Billing Details
Preconditions:
1. API base URL https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com is accessible
2. A registered user exists and a valid bearer token is available
3. A valid cart id exists with at least one product added
Request / Test Steps:
1. Register and log in to obtain a valid bearer token if not already available
2. Create a cart using POST /carts
3. Add at least one product to the cart using POST /carts/{cart_id}
4. Send POST https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com/invoices with Authorization Bearer access_token and an invalid or incomplete JSON body such as missing billing_street billing_city billing_postal_code payment_method or cart_id
5. Review the HTTP status code and validation response
Expected Result:
1. API rejects the invoice request with a client error response such as HTTP 422 Unprocessable Content or HTTP 400 Bad Request
2. Response contains validation feedback indicating missing or invalid billing or invoice fields
3. No successful invoice is created for the invalid request

Title: User Registration Rejected for Password Policy Violation
Preconditions:
1. API base URL https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com is accessible
2. API client or tool is available to send HTTP requests
3. A unique email address is prepared for registration
Request / Test Steps:
1. Send POST https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com/users/register with JSON body containing first_name last_name unique email and a password that violates API policy such as a password without required complexity or a commonly breached password example Welcome01!
2. Review the HTTP status code and response body
3. Attempt to log in with the rejected registration credentials using POST /users/login
Expected Result:
1. Registration is rejected with a client error response such as HTTP 422 Unprocessable Content
2. Response body includes password validation feedback related to complexity and/or breached password rules
3. Login with the rejected credentials does not succeed and no valid bearer token is issued
